research_interests: Multimodal large language models and vision-language models: MLLM/LVLM architecture and training, visual instruction tuning, multimodal reasoning, visual grounding and referring segmentation, video understanding, and attention analysis or interpretability inside LVLMs.
Embodied intelligence: vision-language-action (VLA) models, robot manipulation and learning, grasping, embodied agents, and sim-to-real transfer.

Image and video generation and editing: diffusion models, flow matching, controllable generation, personalization, Gaussian avatars, and motion deblurring or other low-level vision tied to generative pipelines.
LLM agents: agentic systems, tool use, multi-agent collaboration, agent frameworks and agent evaluation or auditing, long-context handling, and data selection for training.
Trustworthiness and evaluation of large models: hallucination measurement and mitigation, safety of fine-tuned models including medical AI safety, benchmarks and honest diagnostic studies.
